name: infoboard
description: Ultra-fast, keyboard-first Chromium desktop extension for searching and switching open tabs across windows.
author: Ryan Tran <https://github.com/ryantr-statinops>

scripts.clean: node -e "import('node:fs/promises').then(fs => fs.rm('extension/dist', { recursive: true, force: true }))"
scripts.build:extension: npm run clean && tsc -p extension/tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-extension-assets.mjs
